output.narrative:
The ctr metric increased by 7.9% (moving from 0.01014 to 0.010943), primarily driven by fill_rate, which contributed 22.68 to the revenue delta. 

Drill-down analysis reveals that this increase was primarily localized to ad_format=rewarded, with an explanatory power of 0.337 and a high lift of 3.88 (rising from 0.021661 to 0.024259). Other segments like ad_format=banner were ruled out with an explanatory power of 0.039 and a low lift of 0.11. 

Going a level deeper within rewarded ads, the movement is further concentrated in vertical=gaming, which had an explanatory power of 0.299 and a lift of 4.96 (rate increasing from 0.017391 to 0.03087). Meanwhile, segments such as campaign_type=CPC were ruled out with an explanatory power of -0.033 and a lift of -0.17.
